designationHistory.indexText: Santee National Wildlife Refuge, encompassing 15,000 acres, was established in 1942 and is located in the upper Atlantic Coastal Plain region of South Carolina.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
